name: Time Limit 2-ka Mae
source:
There were only 2 days left before the new semester.
However, my homework was untouched!
I started working on it with my childhood friend, Sayaka. However, after my mother went out, she suddenly became vigorous.
"Wait, there's very little time left!"
Can I finish my homework?!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE051483.html]DLsite English[/url]]
